description: We are two friends, Salah 9 years and Sara 10 years. We love space, science, and learning new things. We created a fun game about NASA's Opportunity Rover to help other kids learn about Mars and its discoveries. We enjoyed working together and sharing our ideas. We hope you enjoy our project!
summary:
Opportunity: The Last Signal

We made this game using Scratch for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

Our game is about NASA's Opportunity rover and its journey on Mars. Players can join different missions, answer questions, and learn about the rover's discoveries.

In the (Martian Blueberries) mission, players learn about small round rocks called hematite-rich spherules.

In the (Follow the Water) mission, players discover a gypsum vein that shows that liquid water existed on Mars a long time ago.

In (The Last Signal) mission, players learn about Opportunity's final days during a huge dust storm.

We made this game because we love space and wanted to help other kids learn about Mars in a fun way.

We hope you enjoy playing our game and exploring Mars with Opportunity!
details:
How the Project Works

Opportunity: The Last Signal is an educational game we made using Scratch.

In this game, players go on a mission to explore Mars and learn about NASA's Opportunity rover. They listen to the story, answer questions, and complete fun challenges.

The game has three main missions:

  • Martian Blueberries: Players learn about the small, round rocks that Opportunity found on Mars. These rocks are called hematite-rich spherules.
  • Follow the Water: Players discover a gypsum vein in Martian rocks. It is evidence that liquid water existed on Mars a long time ago.
  • The Last Signal: Players learn about the big dust storm that affected Opportunity and what happened during its final days on Mars.

Benefits and Our Goal

We want to make learning about space fun and easy for children.

Our game helps players become curious, think, solve problems, and learn by exploring and answering questions.

We hope more children will enjoy learning about Mars and remember the amazing discoveries made by Opportunity.

Tools and Development

We made our game using Scratch. We used coding blocks, characters, backgrounds, sounds, and buttons to make it interactive.

We also used real NASA pictures and science information to make the game more interesting and educational.

We used ChatGPT as an AI helper for some writing.

Salah created the game idea and worked on building and testing it with support from Sara and Ahmed.

Creativity

We turned a real NASA space mission into a fun game for children.

Players do not just read about Opportunity. They become part of the mission, explore Mars, make choices, answer questions, and discover the rover's story.

We wanted to make Opportunity's discoveries fun to learn about and help keep its story alive.
AI-generated voice narration was created using ElevenLabs. ChatGPT assisted with parts of the project text.
